node_types.name: Subservice
node_types.definition: Internal control-plane subservice running as part of the region_coordinator quorum across regions. Holds no canonical state outside the consensus substrate; mutations are proposed via quorum_core, reads come from state_log.

node_types.name: Log
node_types.definition: Replicated, quorum-committed append log holding canonical region_coordinator state. Writes are durable only after quorum acknowledgement; locally-applied views are read by every subservice that needs canonical state.

nodes.definition: Consensus engine (Raft/multi-Paxos style) deployed as a quorum across regions. Accepts mutation proposals from other subservices, replicates them, and applies committed entries to state_log. Provides the not-itself-a-SPOF property of region_coordinator: any single region or replica can fail without loss of canonical state or progress, as long as a quorum survives. Inter-region channel is a cert-bearing surface (parent R-cert-inventory).

Single committed append-log of all canonical region_coordinator state: per-(tenant, plan_version, tenant_cluster) global aggregated counters; tombstoned flags (throttle, plan-change, cluster-suspended, key revocation, preservation hold, erasure); per-(chain, fork) canonical-tip + tip-stale set; tenant residency policies; rotation schedule + rotation-in-progress tags; offboarding attestations in flight. All entries are committed via quorum_core; subservices read the locally-applied view. Schema is versioned; entries carry HLC timestamps.

Receives sub-second per-(tenant, plan_version, tenant_cluster) usage deltas reported by every region's usage_meter. Maintains rolling global aggregates for rate, cost, concurrent subscriptions, and other plan-bounded resources. When an aggregate crosses a per-plan ceiling or per-cluster quota, proposes a throttle-flag tombstone via quorum_core. Aggregates are bucketed by HLC time, not wall-clock; consults hlc_service. Reads in-force plan_version and cluster membership from state_log. Realizes the global-quota-aggregation responsibility of parent region_coordinator (parent R-global-quota-aggregation, R-cluster-level-quota, R-plan-version-cost-attribution).

Watches state_log for tombstoned flags — throttle (rate, cost), plan-change, cluster-suspended, key-revocation, preservation-hold, erasure-tombstone — and writes them to every region's auth_cache via the unified fast-path that runs ahead of fine-grained counter replication. Flags carry global ordering (HLC) and explicit tombstone identity so cache hydration in any region sees the same revocation state regardless of replication lag direction. Realizes parent R-throttle-flag-fast-path, R-revocation-tombstone, R-plan-tombstone, R-cluster-suspension.

Receives head observations from each region's chain_router, partitioned by (chain, fork). Computes a single canonical-tip view per (chain, fork) by quorum across regional chain pools. Excludes votes from pools currently in tip-stale state (consults state_log). Detects reorgs and proposes coherent rollback notifications keyed on chain coordinates. Proposes canonical-tip and tip-stale set updates via quorum_core; reports the canonical tip back to chain_router and fanout. Realizes parent R-cross-region-canonical-tip, R-cross-region-rollback-coherent, R-stale-pool-quorum-exclusion, R-per-fork-canonical-tip.

Owns each tenant's residency policy (set of regions in which the tenant's data, traffic, and derived telemetry may live). Resolves policy from tenant_store via reads, writes the resolved policy as a versioned record into state_log via quorum_core, and pushes new policy versions out to every consumer (edge, gateway, usage_meter, metrics_store) so they enforce a single coherent view. Handles policy-change tombstones with effective-from semantics. Realizes parent R-residency-policy.

Distributes a hybrid-logical clock (HLC) used by gateway, fanout, and the region_coordinator subservices in place of wall-clock for ordering and time-bucketed enforcement. Each region's hlc_service replica observes inter-region HLC samples and bounds skew explicitly; when observed skew exceeds a threshold, the affected region is signalled into the documented degraded mode. Realizes parent R-bounded-clock-skew.

Schedules and gates rotation events globally. Cert and origin-endpoint rotations are region-staggered: at most one region transitions a given surface inside a maintenance window. Chain pool blue/green rotations are gated to one pool, one region, one wave at a time, and the rotation is only admitted while tip_quorum reports the canonical-tip quorum size above its safe threshold. Tags the rotation-in-progress state in state_log so chain_router's schema-skew and tip-divergence quarantines suppress noise during the documented rotation window. Realizes parent R-cert-rotation-staggered, R-origin-rotation, R-rotation-coordinator-gate, R-rotation-aware-skew.

Driven by erasure-tombstone entries in state_log (committed by other subservices on tenant offboarding). Signals downstream parent components in a documented order: gateway closes subscriptions with structured reason, fanout drops them, address_index tombstones watch claims, chain_router cancels in-flight long-RPCs, usage_meter freezes the cost record. Collects per-component offboarding attestations and proposes them via quorum_core; once all attestations land in state_log, the aggregate certificate of deletion is forwarded to metrics_store's compliance audit trail. Enforces no-resurrection of offboarded tenant identity. Realizes parent R-offboarding-teardown, R-erasure-tombstone, R-no-tenant-resurrection, R-compliance-audit-trail.

requirements.description: Cert and origin-endpoint rotations are region-staggered: at most one region transitions a given cert-bearing surface inside a maintenance window. Simultaneous expiry across regions is prevented by construction.
Origin endpoints (gateway-accepted IP/hostname pairs) rotate on a documented cadence under the same region-staggered gate as cert rotation.
Chain pool rotations are gated globally to one pool, one region, one wave at a time, and are admitted only while the canonical-tip quorum size remains above its safe threshold throughout.
Rotation events surface a 'rotation in progress' tag in state_log so chain_router's schema-skew and tip-divergence quarantines suppress quarantines triggered solely by the documented rotation window.
A single canonical-tip view per (chain, fork) is maintained by quorum across regional chain pools and reported as such; tenants subscribe to or query an explicit (chain, fork) pair.
Canonical-tip quorum excludes votes from any chain pool currently in tip-stale state, so a stalled regional pool cannot anchor the global canonical-tip view.
Reorg rollback notifications are keyed on globally-meaningful chain coordinates so every region emits a coherent rollback regardless of when its local chain pool observed the reorg.

Tenant offboarding triggers an end-to-end teardown sequence: gateway closes subscriptions with structured reason, fanout drops them, address_index tombstones watch claims, chain_router cancels in-flight long-RPCs, usage_meter freezes the cost record. Per-component offboarding attestations are collected into the compliance audit trail.

Per-(tenant, plan_version, tenant_cluster) usage deltas reported by every region's usage_meter are aggregated globally on a sub-second cadence, and crossing a per-plan ceiling or per-cluster quota proposes a throttle-flag tombstone.

Tombstoned flags (throttle, plan-change, cluster-suspended, key-revocation, preservation-hold, erasure-tombstone) propagate to every region's auth_cache via a single unified fast-path that runs ahead of fine-grained counter replication, with global ordering preserved.

Each tenant's residency policy is owned canonically here, written as a versioned record, and pushed to every consumer (edge, gateway, usage_meter, metrics_store) so policy enforcement is consistent across components.

A hybrid-logical clock is distributed to subscribers (gateway, fanout, internal subservices) with bounded inter-region skew; observed skew above threshold puts the affected region into the documented degraded mode.

region_coordinator is logically a single global service but physically deployed as a quorum across regions: failure of any single region or replica does not cause loss of canonical state or progress, as long as a quorum survives.

satisfactions.explanation: lifecycle_gate's definition explicitly says cert and origin-endpoint rotations are region-staggered (at most one region transitions a given surface in a maintenance window); the schedule is held in state_log via quorum_core so the staggering is canonical, not deployment discipline.
lifecycle_gate gates origin-endpoint rotations under the same region-staggered cadence as cert rotation; rotation events are logged via quorum_core into state_log.

lifecycle_gate's definition gates chain pool rotations to one pool / one region / one wave at a time; lifecycle_gate calls tip_quorum to confirm the canonical-tip quorum size is above its safe threshold before admitting the rotation.
lifecycle_gate writes rotation-in-progress tags through quorum_core into state_log; chain_router (parent) reads those tags to suppress quarantines triggered solely by the documented rotation window.

tip_quorum's definition partitions head observations by (chain, fork) and computes a single canonical tip per pair via quorum across regional chain pools; the canonical tip is committed via quorum_core into state_log.
tip_quorum reads tip-stale set from state_log and excludes any tip-stale pool's vote from its quorum computation, so a stalled regional pool cannot anchor the global canonical-tip view.

tip_quorum emits rollback notifications keyed on globally-meaningful chain coordinates (block + intra-block index, or chain-stream sequence) committed via quorum_core, so every region's fanout reads the same coherent rollback from state_log.

offboarding_orchestrator reads erasure tombstones from state_log and signals downstream parent components in the documented order; collected attestations are proposed via quorum_core and the aggregate certificate is forwarded to metrics_store's compliance audit trail.

quota_aggregator receives sub-second per-(tenant, plan_version, tenant_cluster) deltas from every region's usage_meter, maintains rolling global aggregates, and proposes throttle-flag tombstones via quorum_core when ceilings are crossed; HLC bucketing comes from hlc_service.

flag_propagator watches state_log and writes tombstoned flags (throttle, plan-change, cluster-suspended, key revocation, preservation hold, erasure tombstone) to every region's auth_cache via the unified fast-path; global ordering is preserved by HLC committed via quorum_core.

residency_publisher resolves each tenant's residency policy from tenant_store, commits the resolved policy as a versioned record via quorum_core into state_log, and pushes new versions to every consumer.

hlc_service's per-region replica observes inter-region HLC samples, bounds skew explicitly, and signals the affected region into degraded mode when skew exceeds threshold; subscribers (gateway, fanout, internal subservices) receive the distributed HLC.

quorum_core is the consensus engine deployed across regions; canonical state is committed only on quorum acknowledgement and applied to state_log, so failure of any single region or replica does not cause loss of canonical state or progress as long as a quorum survives.
